entities.name: Ridgeline Chemical
entities.summary: Ridgeline Chemical operates the Millbrook plant on the Upper Basin. The Valley Courier reported that a tank at the plant released solvent into the river.{{c:r1-upper-basin-001}} The company said the release was a fraction of the volume alleged.{{c:r1-upper-basin-003}}

timeline.text: Compliance order issued by the Authority

entities.name: Foo Valley Municipal Utility
entities.role: Operator of the Lower Basin treatment works
entities.summary: The utility confirmed a chlorine overdose at the Lower Basin treatment works.{{c:r1-lower-basin-001}} It also issued a boil notice after a main burst in Eastfield.{{c:r2-mainburst-001}}
